title: Some people are exploiting the latest Apple bug to crash your iPhone via Twitter (AAPL, TWTR)
text: Some people are exploiting the latest Apple bug to crash your iPhone via Twitter (AAPL, TWTR) By Edoardo Maggio Feb 19, 2018, 5:39 am 35 pts There's an Apple software bug currently affecting iPhones, iPads, and Macs — and some pranksters are taking advantage of it. The bug means a keyboard character from the Indian language Telugu can crash applications as soon as it shows up in a text field. As Mashable first reported, a number of…
